correctness.rationale: For every k>=2 and kappa>1, the exact Gaussian-KL formula is (2/k)KL=mh-1-log(h)-ell. Direct differentiation gives F_tt=2S/(k^2 t^3)+R^2/(Rt+1)^2-(k-1)/(kt^2). Cauchy SR>=(k-1)^2 and AM-GM imply the strictly positive factor a(1-a^(1/3))(2a^(2/3)+2a^(1/3)-1), a=(k-1)/k>=1/2, so maxima on [1,kappa]^k have only endpoints. Formula H follows by substitution. A strictly convex first derivative with opposite endpoint signs has one zero, giving a unique continuous optimum; endpoint lattice and two asymptotic expansions prove the rest. The packaged verifier independently passed 6987 supplementary tests, including 2600 exact rational curvature calculations. Finite tests are not treated as an infinite proof.
